```{julia}
eta1 = 1
eta2 = 10000
eta3 = 100000000
eta4 = 1000000000000
x = range(-1.0, 1.0, length=1000)
y1 = 1 ./ (1 .+ exp.(-eta1 .* x))
y2 = 1 ./ (1 .+ exp.(-eta2 .* x))
y3 = 1 ./ (1 .+ exp.(-eta3 .* x))
y4 = 1 ./ (1 .+ exp.(-eta4 .* x))
```

```{julia}
fig = Figure(size=(800, 600))
ax = Axis(fig[1,1], xlabel="x", ylabel="sigmoid(x)", title="Sigmoid function for different sensitivities η")
lines!(ax, x, y1, label="η = 1")
lines!(ax, x, y2, label="η = 10^4")
lines!(ax, x, y3, label="η = 100,000,000")
lines!(ax, x, y4, label="η = 1,000,000,000,000")
axislegend(ax)
fig
```
